note: The Feb. 21, 1907 orders on this page are the John E. Kidwell Isthmian transfer and a Secretary of War salary ratification, not the Frank O'Neill reinstatement.
The Mar. 4, 1907 orders on this page appoint John F. Stevens and Goethals to the Isthmian Canal Commission and place Bishop in charge; nothing on Lillie L. Wright.
April 4, 1907 appears only as an arrival deadline in a Mar. 12, 1907 Joint Commission order; no Saturday half-holiday order for War Department employees is printed.
Feb. 20, 1907 is only the approval date of the immigration act cited in the Mar. 14, 1907 Japanese-Korean laborer order; nothing on James H. Adams.
Feb. 20, 1907 is only the approval date of the immigration act cited in the Mar. 14, 1907 order; nothing on Gilman B. Howe or the Census Bureau.
Feb. 20, 1907 is only the approval date of the immigration act cited in the Mar. 14, 1907 order; nothing on the Watertown, South Dakota land district.
The Mar. 14, 1907 order printed here (signed Theodore Roosevelt) refuses entry to Japanese and Korean laborers, not the Civil Service Rule II free-delivery amendment of the same date.
The Mar. 18, 1907 order printed here amends Goethals's allowances as a Commission member, not the Charles P. Galpin Pension Office eligibility.
The Mar. 26, 1907 order printed here authorizes the transfer of W. P. Armstrong, not the Theresa S. Aubright appointment.
The June 11, 1907 order printed here authorizes the transfer of George S. Fox from Isthmian service, not the Samuel H. Cunningham Animal Industry appointment.
